description: This file contains functions for managing relationship data within a document editing context, including fetching related data via GraphQL, processing component props, and handling nested data structures in a KeystoneJS project.

methods.name: addRelationshipData
methods.description: Adds relationship data to nodes, processing 'relationship' and 'component-block' node types, and recursively handling children.

methods.name: fetchRelationshipData
methods.description: Fetches related data for a given relationship, handling single and multiple relationships via GraphQL queries.

methods.name: fetchDataForOne
methods.description: Fetches data for a single related item based on its ID using GraphQL.

methods.name: addRelationshipDataToComponentProps
methods.description: Recursively processes component props to hydrate relationship fields with fetched data.
